notes: Reports dashboard usability patch for the Vita Nova Staff software.
Makes Housing & Intake > Journey Summary table-first so the executive breakdown visibly loads instead of being dominated by the chart panel.
Adds All Youth % and Active % columns to Journey Summary so staff can understand journey stages as an operations breakdown instead of raw counts only.
Normalizes Intake dashboard date display for birth dates, completed dates, and last-updated values.
Adds name search to the Sleep Spot dashboard Guest Log so staff can quickly find a youth stay record.
Builds on Vita Nova Staff 1.0.113 and keeps Java 25 bytecode compatibility for staff computers.
